Elden Ring beginner walkthrough

In Elden Ring, this beginner walkthrough describes the first mission.

  1. Opening route: Follow the marked path to the checkpoint and collect healing supplies before entering the next encounter.
  2. First encounter: Equip the starting weapon and wait for the enemy recovery window before attacking, then save stamina for a dodge.
  3. Return journey: Upgrade the starting weapon at the checkpoint and restore healing supplies before exploring the next route.
